items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: You take right now, I think one of the finest chord men in the business is Johnny St. Cyr. But he can't get a job because he cares solo.

ctx.x: Did he ever take many solos or one-string solos?

Well, no. You see, that's where I was better than he was. You see, that's what made me, as I say, I'm better than my teacher. As far as that goes. You see, my banjo playing today, that's what makes me stand out as a banjo player. It isn't that I make more chords than the other fella, or I read more better than him. I can solo more better than him. You see, I take all single-string solos. We'll say like Charlie Christian or somebody like that. And you get the beauty about taking all them broken-off pegs of yours…
Anything else about John Marrero's style? What kind of a banjo did he use?
